prose.headline: Corsair Gaming snaps back with volume: buy it at $13.08, objective $14.27 by Oct 23, stop under $12.63.
story: Corsair bounced 2.3% on Monday on 1.52× normal volume and reclaimed its 50-day at $12.88 the same day, a clean answer from buyers after the Oct 14 loss of the 20-day. The swings still print higher highs and higher lows, and the stock is up 97% in six months, so the bigger trend is firmly up.

RSI rose to 48 from 45. MACD is still under its signal, and the 20-day at $13.50 is the next hurdle. Above it sits the old support line, now overhead at $14.27: that is the target. The VWAP since the last earnings at $12.85 sits right under the entry, and the stock has lagged the S&P by 2.9 points in a month, so there is ground to make up.

prose.headline: Park Hotels Resorts presses toward fresh highs: buy $16.11, target $16.98 by Oct 26, out under $15.85.
story: Park Hotels reclaimed both the 20-day and the 50-day on Oct 15 and has held above them since. The swings print higher highs and higher lows, and Monday's 1.3% gain closed it at $16.11, just under the weekly swing high at $16.20 and the 52-week high at $16.38; it has outpaced the S&P by 6.8 points in a month.

RSI rose to 64 from 61 and MACD is above its signal after crossing up on Oct 15; price is above the VWAP since the last earnings at $15.32 and above the $14.91 to $15.80 high-volume range, so the heavy trading sits below as support. Volume is ordinary at 0.90× normal: no rush, no exodus, just a stock grinding toward its highs.
